fyt.name: Pressure
fyt.tagline: Workout streak app for iPhone and Apple Watch

_sources.app_store_since, rating, rating_count, l: https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6783633047&country=us (releaseDate, averageUserRating, userRatingCount, version, currentVersionReleaseDate); re-read daily
_sources.rating_count, review_count: the higher of the lookup's userRatingCount and the listing's totalNumberOfRatings (the listing runs a day or more ahead: 10 on 2026-09-28 while the lookup said 9); review_count = distinct written reviews on the listing's all-reviews page (?see-all=reviews), 5 on 2026-09-28, matching James's count; both re-read daily and never lowered
_sources.users: read-only query of the production database counting app users, excluding the developer's own account; re-read daily, and users_as_of is the date of the published reading
_sources.commits_since_2026_05_01: git rev-list --count HEAD --since=2026-05-01 in the Pressure repository (3425 on 2026-09-23; first commit is 2026-05-01)
_sources.swiftui_files: Swift files importing SwiftUI in the Pressure iOS app (283 on 2026-09-23)
_sources.stack: the Pressure API's package.json (fastify, drizzle-orm, pg-boss) and its Fly.io config
_sources.updates_since_launch: the App Store listing's version history: one dated entry per public release after the launch release, the first 1.0.17 (2026-07-07); re-counted daily
_sources.chat_posts, chat_posts_since: read-only query of the production database: announcements with sent_to_imessage_at set (count, earliest date), re-read daily; on 2026-09-24, 438 posts covered 346 distinct workouts (a workout can be posted to more than one group chat), so the page says "workout posts"
_sources.background_upload_since: version 1.0.43 release notes and App Store listing: a run finished on the Watch reaches Pressure in the background; only workouts recorded by Pressure's own Watch app
_sources.app_store_url: the App Store lookup's trackViewUrl for id 6783633047, read 2026-10-07
_sources.site_url: Pressure's public website, which James built
